headline.text: Passivation chemical bottle found in L1 general production area — *no food-contact use*, returned to fab shop.

summary: One active hold resolved — L1 S4 excess-salt caramel removed and released within 55 minutes. Chemical control gap at L1: passivation bottle misplaced in production area. Five sanitation flags across L1 and L3, all resolved same-shift.

holds.title: Excess salt in S4 caramel
holds.summary: Caramel on S4 conveyor belt tested out of spec for salt at 10:30 AM; all affected product removed from line and production restarted at 11:25 AM after verification.
holds.status: Resolved — product removed, caramel confirmed in spec, production resumed at 11:25 AM.

food_safety.title: Passivation chemical in production area
food_safety.summary: Unlabeled bottle of passivation chemical (fabrication shop use only) found in L1 general production area; maintenance confirmed not for general access and removed.
food_safety.status: Resolved — chemical identified as fab-shop passivation agent, removed from production floor by 09:45 AM.

quality.title: S2 checkweigher out of calibration
quality.summary: S2 checkweigher flagged as not calibrated at 08:58 AM; maintenance called to recalibrate.
quality.status: Open — maintenance called, calibration status at window close unknown.

quality.title: Truffle guillotine belt peeling
quality.summary: Guillotine belt on Truffle line showing inner-side peeling after two fouling stops in one shift; belt was replaced recently and now exhibiting abnormal wear.
quality.status: Open — line running, belt peeling documented, investigation ongoing.

quality.title: S3 MM4 exposed pieces
quality.summary: 3 exposed caramel pieces out of 28 observed on MM4 during Heath Cluster trial at 14:40 MT.
quality.status: Trial in progress — acceptable rate for trial phase, monitoring continues.

quality.title: S3 MM5 doubles and broken pieces
quality.summary: 1 double, 2 broken pieces out of 604 observed on MM5 during Heath Cluster trial at 15:11 MT.
quality.status: Trial in progress — acceptable rate for trial phase, monitoring continues.

quality.title: ML4 bar appearance — staining
quality.summary: 3–5 pieces per mold on ML4 showing appearance stains at 07:56 AM; operator made adjustments.
quality.status: Resolved — adjustments made, no recurrence noted.

sanitation.title: S3 filter hose not washed
sanitation.summary: S3 kitchen filter hose found clogged at startup (05:19 AM); internal piping not washed during prior cleaning cycle.

sanitation.title: Truffle guillotine belt fouling
sanitation.summary: Guillotine belt stopped twice in one shift (11:03 AM and 15:11 PM) due to chocolate buildup; belt dirty enough to halt operation after 5 hours runtime.
sanitation.status: Resolved — belt cleaned both times, scrapers found worn or mispositioned, tunnel temps being adjusted to centerline.

sanitation.title: Milk spill not cleaned after tote move
sanitation.summary: Milk tote moved from S3 pack area left floor uncleaned at 08:47 AM; warehouse team cleaned Friday but tote continued leaking over weekend.
sanitation.status: Resolved — tote identified in S4 kitchen by 09:45 AM, area cleaned.

sanitation.title: Soap dispensers non-functional
sanitation.summary: Two soap dispensers in L1 non-functional at 11:09 AM; one needed batteries, one required replacement.
sanitation.status: Resolved — one dispenser replaced, one bottle changed, both operational by 15:35 PM.

sanitation.title: ML4 TG5 rollers fouled with wrap
sanitation.summary: TG5 rollers inside box found with affogato wrap rolled into them at 14:00 MT; operator cleared.

opportunities.text: Review chemical storage and labeling procedures — passivation chemical bottle found unsecured in general production area, suggesting control gap for non-food-grade materials.
Add filter-hose inspection to S3 startup checklist — today's clogged hose traced to incomplete internal-piping wash on prior shift.
Investigate guillotine belt specification and installation procedure — replacement belt on Truffle line fouling twice in 8 hours and now peeling, suggesting material or setup issue.
